# krcw: paced
# KRCW Europe / Russia on_actions (generated by build/content_europe.py -> eu_p10_onactions.py)
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = SOV }
				SOV = {
					# succession faction strengths; the death event seeds these too,
					# set here as well so the backing decisions work before 1954
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_variable = krcw_sov_mil } }
						set_variable = { krcw_sov_mil = 40 }
						set_variable = { krcw_sov_civ = 25 }
						set_variable = { krcw_sov_mon = 10 }
						set_variable = { krcw_sov_ext = 15 }
					}
					# Savinkov's last years and his death (1953.6 / 1954.3.11)
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_savinkov_dead } }
						country_event = { id = krcw_sov.1 days = 725 random_days = 25 }
						country_event = { id = krcw_sov.2 days = 845 random_days = 8 }
					}
					# the Council finally decides, 1958.2
					country_event = { id = krcw_sov.20 days = 1447 random_days = 12 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# Failsafe: on the free route Savinkov may outlive 1954 entirely, and on any route a
	# player may drag the interregnum past 1958. Re-check monthly so the succession always
	# resolves rather than leaving the crisis spirit on SOV forever.
	on_monthly_SOV = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = KRCW_savinkov_dead
					NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_russian_succession_over }
					date > 1953.5.9
				}
				country_event = { id = krcw_sov.20 days = 3 }
			}
		}
	}

	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the wire, both sides
	# eu_p26 gave the DDR krcw_ddr_emigration and eu_p31 gave WGR krcw_wgr_arrivals, but every
	# focus and option touching them PUSHES THEM DOWN (the regime closing the gap, the Republic
	# absorbing arrivals). Nothing made the haemorrhage worse on its own, so the variable could
	# only fall: max reachable was 28 against staged events gated at >39 and >69, and the whole
	# storyline - the Leipzig locomotive works, "the country is leaking", and the second route to
	# sealing the sector border - was unreachable. check_content.py caught it.
	#
	# The premise is that an open sector line bleeds people continuously, so the pressure must
	# accrue on its own and the player's decisions push back against a rising number. +2/month
	# from a base of 20 crosses 39 in about ten months and 69 in about two years, matching the
	# pace of the events. Sealing the border stops it; that is the point of sealing it.
	on_monthly_DDR = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = krcw_ddr_emigration
					NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_berlin_sector_sealed }
					NOT = { has_idea = krcw_ddr_the_stopped_wound }
				}
				add_to_variable = { krcw_ddr_emigration = 2 }
				# a republic worth staying in slows the bleed without a wall
				if = {
					limit = { has_idea = krcw_ddr_the_civilian_turn }
					add_to_variable = { krcw_ddr_emigration = -1 }
				}
				clamp_variable = { var = krcw_ddr_emigration min = 0 max = 100 }
			}
		}
	}

	# The far end of the same flow: what the DDR loses, WGR receives. Rises while the line is
	# open, faster under the open-door law, so the Republic's housing argument keeps its teeth.
	on_monthly_WGR = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = krcw_wgr_arrivals
					NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_berlin_sector_sealed }
				}
				add_to_variable = { krcw_wgr_arrivals = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_idea = krcw_wgr_the_open_door }
					add_to_variable = { krcw_wgr_arrivals = 1 }
				}
				clamp_variable = { var = krcw_wgr_arrivals min = 0 max = 100 }
			}
		}
	}
}
